announcement.title: Halofy-owned analytics and a one-time usage summary
announcement.description: Product analytics now goes only to Halofy’s PostHog account, using a random installation identity instead of provider account IDs. This update also sends a one-time summary of retained local usage: project and thread counts, past turn outcomes, provider/model choices, tokens and durations where recorded. It does not send prompts, code, paths or messages as analytics. To opt out, set T3CODE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false before starting Halofy. Diagnostic logs remain local unless you configure an approved Halofy collector. Upstream service defaults are removed; authorized provider connections and Halofy Connect remain supported. Includes the already-merged Terms signup gate and existing Apps improvements.
